title: Order Granting Intervention of the Idaho Public Utilities Commission (Docket No. 23-057-16)
text:
- BEFORE THE PUBLIC SERVICE COMMISSION OF UTAH - 

Joint Application of Questar Gas Company 
dba Dominion Energy Utah and Enbridge 
Quail Holdings, LLC for Approval of the 
Proposed Sale of Fall West Holdco, LLC 
to Enbridge Quail Holdings, LLC 

DOCKET NO. 23-057-16 

ORDER GRANTING INTERVENTION 

ISSUED: February 22, 2024 

On January 30, 2024, the Idaho Public Utilities Commission petitioned for leave 
to intervene in this docket. 

Because no party has objected to the petition and good cause otherwise 
appears to exist, the Public Service Commission (PSC) will grant intervention. 
Intervention is conditioned upon the intervenor’s representatives participating in this 
matter adhering to the Utah Standards of Professionalism and Civility adopted by the 
Utah Supreme Court October 16, 2003. (These may be reviewed at internet web 
address http://www.utcourts.gov/courts/sup/civility.htm or a copy obtained by request 
made to the PSC.) 

The PSC may condition intervenor’s participation in these proceedings based 
upon such factors as whether intervenor is directly and adversely impacted by issues 
raised in the proceedings; whether intervenor’s interests are adequately represented 
by another party; the number of persons seeking intervention or already intervened; 
and how intervenor’s participation will affect the just, orderly and prompt conduct of 
the proceedings. 

DOCKET NO. 23-057-16 

- 2 - 

ORDER 

Leave to intervene is granted to the Idaho Public Utilities Commission. 
Intervention is granted as described above. 

DATED at Salt Lake City, Utah, February 22, 2024.
